title: Sage perk record
description: A perk record (PerkRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another perk record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

name.description: What a screen calls it; empty: its id. (string, default "")

description.description: What it does, in words a screen shows. (string, default "")

effects.description: Applied when it is granted, with the one who has it as their source: a lasting effect (Infinite) for a bonus that stays, an instant one for a base value raised for good. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

requires.description: Must all hold for the one who picks it: { "skill": "blade", "atLeast": 4 }, { "level": "character", "atLeast": 2 }, { "has_perk": "x" }. (List<ICondition>)

requires+.description: Adds to "requires": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

requires-.description: Removes these from "requires" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

cost.description: Perk points it costs (rpg_conventions perkPoints); a trait costs nothing. At least 0. (float, default 1)

trait.description: A trait: chosen at character creation (a prefab's perks part) or granted (grant_perk), never picked with points. (bool, default false)
